info.title: CryptoPulse API
info.description: Global cryptocurrency intelligence API. 10 endpoints: DeFi yield farming across Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Solana (DeFiLlama live TVL + APY), personalized strategy builder, crypto security framework (with Ledger/Trezor hardware wallet links), threat intelligence, exchange comparison (with Coinbase/Gemini/Kraken/Binance exchange affiliate links, experience-aware), crypto tax guidance for 20+ countries (with Koinly/CoinLedger tax software links), beginner onboarding (exchange links), spending guide, crypto-friendly banking, and merchant payment setup. Powered by CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, Fear & Greed Index, and Tavily. All require x402 micropayment (USDC on Base).

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 payment signature. Send a GET request without this header to receive a 402 with payment requirements. Sign the payment and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

get.summary: Compare live DeFi yields with risk-adjusted rankings
get.description: Real-time DeFi yield opportunities ranked by risk-adjusted return across protocols and chains. Includes Berachain PoL spotlight, protocol TVL data, and entry steps.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter by chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum, berachain, solana, or all

200.description: DeFi yield opportunities with rankings and entry steps

402.description: Payment required. Respond with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to proceed.

get.x-agent-chaining: Pair with /api/security to ensure self-custody setup before depositing into protocols

get.summary: Build a personalized DeFi strategy for goals and risk
get.description: Custom DeFi allocation plan with step-by-step entry paths for your capital, risk tolerance, and goals. Agent-executable output.

200.description: Personalized DeFi strategy with allocations and entry/exit paths

get.x-agent-chaining: Follow with /api/yield for specific DeFi pools matching the recommended strategy

get.summary: Scan token/address risk and harden self-custody setup
get.description: Live on-chain risk scan via GoPlus when a token or wallet address is provided: honeypot/rug/tax traps for tokens, sanctions/phishing/mixer screening for addresses, across 7 EVM chains. Plus hardware wallet selection, seed phrase storage, multi-sig setup, and smart contract approval hygiene tailored to holdings value.

parameters.name: value_tier
parameters.description: Approximate holdings value tier used to calibrate custody recommendations

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional token contract address to risk-scan via GoPlus (honeypot, buy/sell tax, mint/rug traps)

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Optional wallet address to screen via GoPlus (sanctions, phishing, mixer, malicious activity)

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: EVM chain for the token/address scan (default ethereum)

200.description: Security framework with prioritized action list; when token/address supplied, includes token_risk and address_risk GoPlus scan results

get.x-agent-chaining: Response includes Ledger/Trezor hardware wallet links for self-custody

get.summary: Report current crypto threats and active scam patterns
get.description: Current attack vectors, scam patterns, and defense playbook for crypto holders. Includes phishing, drainers, SIM swap, rug pulls, and more.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Threat category: phishing, drainer, sim_swap, rug_pull, flash_loan, or all

200.description: Threat intelligence with defenses and incident response

get.summary: Compare crypto exchanges on fees, custody, jurisdiction
get.description: Compare crypto exchanges by country, priority, and experience level. Includes fees, security record, regulatory status, and fiat on-ramp options.

200.description: Exchange comparison with fee table and security recommendations

get.x-agent-chaining: Response includes exchange affiliate links matched to experience level (beginner/trader)

get.summary: Explain crypto tax treatment for a given jurisdiction
get.description: Jurisdiction-specific tax obligations, optimization strategies (tax loss harvesting, cost basis methods), and reporting tool recommendations.

parameters.name: activities
parameters.description: Comma-separated: hold, trade, defi, mining, staking, nft, business

parameters.name: tax_year
parameters.description: Tax year e.g. 2026. Defaults to current year.

200.description: Tax guidance with obligations, strategies, and tool recommendations

get.x-agent-chaining: Response includes Koinly/CoinLedger tax software links; supports 20+ countries

get.summary: Guide a first-time crypto buyer from zero to first hold
get.description: End-to-end guide for new crypto buyers: exchange selection, KYC walkthrough, first purchase, wallet setup, and DCA plan.

200.description: Onboarding guide with exchange recommendation and DCA plan

get.x-agent-chaining: Response includes Coinbase/Gemini/Kraken exchange links; follow with /api/security for self-custody setup

get.summary: Find where to spend crypto and how to pay with it
get.description: Best crypto debit cards, merchant acceptance, gift card platforms, and bill pay options by country.

200.description: Spending options with card comparison and tax implications

get.summary: Find crypto-friendly banks and fiat on/off ramps
get.description: Banks and neobanks with high crypto tolerance, de-banking risk assessment, and on/off ramp alternatives by country.

200.description: Banking recommendations with de-banking risk and on-ramp options

get.summary: Set up crypto payment acceptance for a merchant
get.description: Compare crypto payment processors for your business type: BTCPay Server, Coinbase Commerce, NOWPayments, Strike, and more.

200.description: Processor comparison with setup guide and settlement strategy

get.summary: Deliver an institutional crypto brief: spot, derivs, flows
get.description: Premium multi-source crypto market intelligence brief for advisor/trading agents. Returns regime, key levels, catalysts, derivatives positioning, on-chain flows, risks and opportunities as structured JSON.
